description: Create or change a table of contents style: its title, the paragraph styles it collects, and the level, entry style, page number and separator of each (Layout > Table of Contents Styles). Keep one style per table (contents, figures, tables) to build several.

entries.description: Paragraph styles to include, in order. An entry for a style the TOC style already includes is updated

pageNumberStyle.description: Character style for the page number

separator.description: Text between entry and number (^t is a tab, ^y right-indent tab)

sortAlphabetically.description: Sort entries at this level alphabetically

epubNavigation.description: Also use this style for EPUB navigation (the TOC style in EPUB export options)

name.description: TOC style name; created when it does not exist

options.description: Style options; only the ones given change

createBookmarks.description: Create PDF bookmarks from the entries

frameDirection.description: Text direction of the generated frame

includeBookDocuments.description: Include every document of the book this document belongs to

makeAnchor.description: Make a text anchor in each source paragraph so entries link to it

numberedParagraphs.description: What to keep of numbered paragraphs

removeForcedLineBreak.description: Remove forced line breaks from entries

runIn.description: Run all entries into one paragraph

title.description: Title text above the table of contents

replaceEntries.description: Remove the style's current entries before adding these

name: define_toc_style
title: Define Toc Style
